value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor graph is the canonical unique (8_3) incidence Levi graph and a maximally symmetric 16-site cubic network. The full 6435-cut Schmidt/Smith distribution is a natural complete many-body entanglement invariant, not a parameter-arbitrary slice. It reveals an isolated three-unit characteristic-three defect, qualitatively stronger than the previously observed one-unit Heawood effect, while establishing no further exceptional primes. The exact data can benchmark graph-state resource characterization and incidence arithmetic; this is a complete natural finite result and does not require an invented large-size theorem.
